text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(—My legs feel light. Spurred on by my 
racing heart, 
I sprint toward the victory before my 
eyes.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Now I can see it. The goalpost ahead of 
me. 
And beyond that path, the grand ambition I 
must seize.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, with this—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: (—I can show them the true Phalaenopsis.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now, out of my way... Begone! 
Stand in awe, and engrave it into your 
memory!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The sight of my back, leaving you all 
behind!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I couldn't help but laugh out of pure 
joy. 
Because right there... was the master 
I had admired from the very beginning.
choice_data_list:
Looks like there's no need to worry 
anymore.

Looks like there's no need to worry 
anymore, huh?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I have returned.
choice_data_list: Great work! That was an incredible run!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Heh, it has been far too long 
since I last ran a race that made my blood 
sing like this.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: At this rate, in time...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—I may even reach the greatest reigning 
queen of our era.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Now then. I must not slacken my resolve; 
I must continue to hone myself. 
Were I to let up now and fail to be ready 
by late autumn, 
it would all come to naught.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. Let's keep giving it our all for the 
next race!

Yeah. Let's keep doing our best for the 
next race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That said, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup 
where she'd clash 
with Mejiro Dober wouldn't be held until 
November.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To keep her racing instincts from dulling, 
I wanted her 
to run in at least one graded race before 
then.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. 
In that case, I have a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—I wish to test my mettle against my 
peers.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fret not, Trainer. I am no longer 
blinded by their brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
This is no mere fixation on 'defeating' 
them. 
Rather... as one of the 'Tiara Umamusume,' 
I wish to demonstrate my strength.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And as the club's 'pioneer,' as well. 
I want to make my prowess known.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I shall declare that Phalaenopsis is here. 
—Spe and the others are ideal rivals for 
that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I judged her state while looking into her 
eyes. 
Neither her words nor her expression 
betrayed any impatience.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that case, there was no problem. I 
suggested 
one race from the list I had prepared.
choice_data_list: How about the Sapporo Kinen? There—

What do you say to the Sapporo Kinen? 
There—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She would be there. A veteran of the 
Classic Triple Crown 
who clashed with Special Week and King 
Halo, and 
claimed both the Satsuki Sho and Kikuka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A trickster adept at manipulating the pace 
to bewilder 
those around her and bend the turf to her 
will. 
—One of this generation's finest, Seiun 
Sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Phalaenopsis could deliver results at 
the Sapporo Kinen 
against her, it would undeniably prove her 
strength. 
When I made the proposal—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, splendid. 
Let us do so.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Let us give Sky a full taste 
of the searing heat dwelling within my 
embers.
